name: SourceSelection
description: Runs a FAR Part 15 best-value source selection for one solicitation, from proposal intake through individual evaluation, SSEB consensus, price evaluation and the Source Selection Authority's award decision. Agents draft findings and decision language with proposal-page citations; named officials make every judgment.

data.description: Contracting Officer starts the case from the SS_Workspace app with the solicitation ID and panel assignments

data.label: Proposal Intake
data.description: Loads every offeror's proposal volumes, extracts structured fields, indexes the text for citation, screens compliance and responsibility, and has the Contracting Officer release proposals to evaluation.

tasks.description: Reads each offeror's proposal volumes from the SS-Proposals bucket, extracts the offeror identity and price schedule from the cover letter and price volume, and writes page-level text and offeror records to Data Fabric.

Checks each offeror's proposal against the plan's submission instructions and checks responsibility data (SAM active registration, exclusions, FAPIIS records), writing a compliance finding per offeror.
The Contracting Officer reviews the compliance screen, confirms which offerors proceed, and either releases proposals to the SSEB or cancels the solicitation.

data.label: Individual Evaluation
data.description: Drafts strengths, weaknesses, deficiencies and risks for every offeror against every evaluation factor, then each SSEB evaluator independently reviews, edits and rates their assigned factors.

tasks.description: For every offeror and every non-price factor in the evaluation plan, runs the SS_EvaluationAssistant agent grounded on that offeror's proposal and saves its draft findings, each with a proposal page citation, to Data Fabric.

Evaluator 1 reviews the agent's draft findings for their assigned factors across all offerors, accepts, edits or rejects each finding, adds their own, assigns adjectival ratings, and attests to independence.
Evaluator 2 independently reviews, edits and rates their assigned factors across all offerors.
Evaluator 3 independently reviews, edits and rates their assigned factors across all offerors.

data.label: Consensus
data.description: Compiles individual evaluations, has the SS_ConsensusAnalyst agent surface disagreements and draft consensus language, and has the SSEB Chair set consensus ratings and sign the SSEB report.

tasks.description: Reads every evaluator's findings and ratings from Data Fabric and compiles them, per offeror and factor, into one evaluation set with rating spreads.

The SS_ConsensusAnalyst agent identifies where evaluators disagree (rating spread, conflicting findings), proposes consensus ratings with rationale citing the underlying findings, and lists the questions the Chair should resolve.

body.description: One proposed consensus per offeror and factor

spread.description: Distance in scale steps between the highest and lowest individual rating

proposedRating.description: Proposed consensus rating, exactly as written in the scale

rationale.description: Two to four sentences tying the proposed rating to specific findings

supportingFindingIds.description: Finding ids the rationale relies on

chairQuestions.description: Questions the SSEB Chair should resolve with evaluators, or 'None'

tasks.description: The SSEB Chair reviews disagreements and the agent's proposed consensus, sets the consensus rating and narrative for each offeror and factor, and either signs the SSEB report or reconvenes evaluators.

data.label: Price Evaluation
data.description: Computes each offeror's total evaluated price, compares it with the independent government cost estimate and checks for unbalanced pricing; the Contracting Officer records the price reasonableness determination.

tasks.description: Computes total evaluated price per offeror from the extracted price schedules, variance to the IGCE, and flags line items priced far from the IGCE as potentially unbalanced.
The Contracting Officer reviews the price analysis, records the reasonableness determination for each offeror, and proceeds to the award decision or cancels the solicitation.

data.label: Award Decision
data.description: Drafts the comparative best-value analysis and SSDD, has the Source Selection Authority make and sign the award decision, and publishes the award record with its full audit trail.

tasks.description: Assembles the evaluation plan summary and the SSEB consensus record — each consensus rating with its rationale and the evaluator-accepted findings and proposal citations behind it — for the decision writer.

The SS_DecisionWriter agent drafts the comparative analysis and SSDD using the plan's basis for award and factor importance, consensus ratings with their supporting findings, and the price analysis, citing the SSEB record for every discriminator.

body.description: The findings that drive the tradeoff

citation.description: Proposal volume and page, or finding id

tasks.description: The Source Selection Authority reviews the comparative analysis, selects the offeror representing the best value, edits and signs the SSDD.

data.taskTitle: Make and sign the source selection decision
data.name: =bindings.bTf5Nv8Qe

tasks.description: Renders the signed SSDD, SSEB consensus report and full decision audit trail to PDF in the SS-Records bucket and marks the solicitation awarded in Data Fabric.

data.label: Reconvene Evaluators
data.description: Evaluators respond to the Chair's questions and revise their individual findings or ratings before consensus resumes.

tasks.description: Evaluators answer the Chair's consensus questions and update their findings and ratings in the evaluation record.

data.label: Solicitation Cancelled
data.description: Records the cancellation and closes the solicitation.

tasks.description: Marks the solicitation cancelled in Data Fabric and writes a cancellation memo with the Contracting Officer's rationale to the SS-Records bucket.
